title: Purchase terms
intro: AllThePartyGames is a collection of party games for adults aged 18 and over. These terms explain what you can pay for in the store and how it works.
sections: Premium: a one-time payment that keeps Spicy and Chaos open forever in every game, with no ads to watch. 2-hour pass and Party night pass: one-time payments that keep Spicy and Chaos open for 2 or 6 hours in every game, with no ads to watch; the time starts when you buy them. Without buying anything, Spicy and Chaos open for free after watching a short ad: each day, the first two ads open them for 30 minutes and any later ones for 15 minutes. The current content and price are the ones Google Play or the App Store shows before you confirm; they may vary by country.
Payment is handled by Google Play or Apple, not by us. Refunds are requested from the store under its own rules, and a refund may remove what was bought.
Purchases are tied to your store account. If you change phones or reinstall the app, use Restore purchases in the app’s Shop with the same account.
The app is for adults aged 18 and over, and purchases must be made by an adult. If a minor has made a purchase, write to us at {email} and we will look into it.
Nobody has to do a dare or a penalty: the group decides the penalties and anyone who doesn’t want to can pass. Play with respect.
AllThePartyGames is published by Brais López Arias (private individual). Contact: {email}.
How we handle data is explained in the {privacyLink}.
